name: Pregnancy-Associated Mortality
description: This dataset contains records of pregnancy-associated deaths, organized by year, with each row reporting a count of deaths for a combination of cause-of-death classification, racial or ethnic group, and borough. It distinguishes between deaths where pregnancy was a related factor and deaths attributed to an underlying cause, and it includes a numeric deaths column giving the count for each combination. With 236 sampled rows and six columns, the data supports analysis of how pregnancy-associated mortality varies over time and across racial and ethnic groups and geographic areas. It could be used to identify disparities, track trends, compare borough-level patterns, and examine differences between related and underlying causes of death.
